script_text: Stop! Scorpio, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars is squaring your ruling planet Pluto while your Sun in watery Scorpio meets a powerful conjunction in the 8th House of intimacy, shared power, and deep transformation. This is heavy, magnetic, and deeply private. Your emotional truth is magnified tonight, and secrets may surface where you least expect them. In love, Pluto conjunct your Sun is igniting the 8th House tonight, so a secret attraction or buried bond may finally come into focus. If partnered, watch for an 8th House power struggle over trust, control, or money. Avoid trying to control the other person's purse strings, but an unexpected release could bring real freedom. Breathe before you act. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
